We are looking for a PhD position to join the ERC project HALF in my research group. We are looking for someone that has experience with formalization and an interest in analysis. The position is for three years and the starting date is 1st October 2026 (or earlier).

You can apply via MathJobs: https://www.mathjobs.org/jobs/list/28182
The application deadline is the 15th of April. When applying you should state that you want to be mentored by me. If you do, you will automatically apply to both the department-wide positions, and to the specific ERC position.
More information about doing a PhD in Bonn can be found here: https://www.mathematics.uni-bonn.de/hsm-school/bigs
Feel free to reach out by DM or email if you have any questions.
